artworks.title: M. Frémouillot je vous y prends, vous connaissez...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated at a table. Both men are shown from the waist up in a side profile, each facing the other. The man on the left has a pronounced nose and chin, with receding hair that is short and slightly unkempt. He is wearing a long-sleeved garment with wide, scrunched sleeves and is positioned leaning forward with both arms outstretched across the table. The man on the right has thin, curly hair and a similarly prominent nose and chin. He wears a jacket over what appears to be a light-colored shirt or cravat and has his hands resting on the table. Both men are engaged in what appears to be an animated discussion with game pieces scattered on the table between them. The background is a simple wall, and there is a hat hanging on a peg behind the man on the right.

artworks.title: L'instituteur: votre fils me fera honneur!...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a classroom-like setting. The first person is partially visible from the waist up on the left. The second person is in the center, shown from the chest up, leaning towards the third individual on the right. The third person, on the right, is viewed from the chest up and is leaning towards the central figure. In the background, there is a roughly drawn map or chart hanging from the wall.

artworks.title: L'ouie
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting beside a bed where two figures lie. The woman faces the bed, appearing to speak or call out. She has long, light-colored hair, a distinct nose, and a prominent chin. She wears a nightshirt and a pointed nightcap. One figure in bed has short, dark hair and appears to be asleep. The other figure, likely a child, sits in bed with an open-mouthed expression, wearing a bonnet and wrapped in a blanket. Intricately patterned drapes fill the background around the bed.

artworks.title: Vois-tu Bertrand...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated at a table in a café or restaurant. The men are facing each other, with their upper bodies visible. The man on the right has curled hair and exaggerated facial features, wearing a dark coat and holding a cup. The man on the left has short, straight hair and a long nose, gesturing towards a plate with a spoon, wearing a light-colored shirt. The table is set with plates and silverware. Behind them, another man is standing and pouring a beverage with a kettle, showing a bald head and profile view. Other patrons are partially visible in the background, with the café's name, "CAFÉ RESTAURANT DACNAUX," written in large letters.

artworks.title: Ce matin avant l'aurore...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two people sitting in bed with a blanket covering their bodies. Both are sitting upright facing forward. The person on the right has a smile and a round face, wearing a nightcap with flowers. They both have smiling or neutral expressions. Their hair is obscured by the headgear. They wear bedclothes, with a lit candle on a nearby table. A child is standing to the left wearing a nightshirt, looking at a piece of paper or artwork held by the adults. The adults are holding a paper with faces or masks drawn on it. The background is a bedroom with a curtain drawn to one side, revealing the bed. The style is monochromatic, resembling an old charcoal or pencil drawing.

artworks.title: Tu te plains toujours, tu n'es jamais content.
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a family of four standing outdoors in the rain. The man on the right is clutching a child against his chest with one arm and holding the hand of another child with the other hand. The woman on the left is carrying an umbrella and they are all dressed in old-fashioned clothing. The background shows tall buildings and rain falling, with puddles on the ground.

artworks.title: Le mari. Bobonne veux-tu l'étrenne de ma barbe?
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: There are two figures in the image. One figure is standing slightly hunched, leaning forward and pointing at his chin. The second figure is seated in a high-backed chair with her hands resting on an object in her lap. The man has exaggerated facial features, short hair, and is wearing a loose, long-sleeved shirt, dark trousers, and shoes. The woman is wearing a headscarf or cap, a long dress with patterns, and is looking up at the man. The background shows a simple, textured wall and what appears to be an interior setting with curtains to the right.

artworks.title: Voilà le moment (passé minuit) o∙ le calme et la paix règnent véritablement dans les heureux ménages. Vaut mieux tard que jamais.
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic nighttime scene. The image shows a bed with a canopy overhead, featuring two figures lying beneath the covers, with only their heads and part of their bodies visible. A small bassinette or cradle is positioned beside the bed, partially visible and seeming to hold a sleeping infant. The room appears dimly lit, suggesting it could be nighttime. The drawing employs strong contrasts in shading and line work to create depth and texture, emphasizing the gentle folds of the canopy and bedding. The title and text at the top and bottom of the drawing add context but remain secondary to the visual elements.

artworks.title: Bonsoir chérie...si ton épicier nous voyait...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two people in the foreground engaging in a kiss. They are both in profile, with the man bending towards the woman, who is slightly leaning back. The man wears a dark coat and a top hat. The woman's clothing is not distinctly detailed; she appears to have her head covered with a hood or a scarf. Both individuals are depicted without clear facial details due to the simplistic sketch style. In the background, there is a building facade featuring the word "EPICERIE." Above them, slightly to the left, another figure is visible, peering out from behind half-closed shutters of a window. This person wears a nightcap, peering downwards toward the couple with their head resting on their hand. The setting suggests an urban environment, and the scene is rendered in a monochrome, sketch-like style.

artworks.title: Une profession de foi
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two main figures in the foreground. The figure on the left is standing upright with hands behind his back, dressed in a long black coat, white shirt, and light-colored pants, topped with a tall black hat. He has a short beard and mustache, and his dark hair is mostly covered by the hat. The figure on the right is also depicted standing with arms out. This person has a bald head, large eyes, and wears a simple garment resembling a towel tied around the waist. In the background, there are two figures; one is standing with a towel draped over one shoulder, while the other is diving into a pool area. The scene appears to take place in an indoor setting with a pool and architectural elements.

artworks.title: Pélerinage de St Roch
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a stone wall extending horizontally from the left. A curled dog rests in the right corner against the wall, with a vast body of water stretching to the horizon beyond. The horizon line is slightly above the center of the composition, with faint outlines of distant landforms visible against the sky, suggesting mountainous terrain. The artwork features delicate pencil or charcoal strokes, giving a soft and textured quality to the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray to convey a serene and subdued aesthetic.

artworks.title: L'inconvénient de se faire bichonner ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a seated position, engaged in a dramatic scene. The person on the left is leaning back with their head turned to the right, wearing a patterened jacket and holding tongs. The second individual is leaning forward with one hand gesturing upwards, wearing a garment resembling a robe or toga and a laurel leaf wreath. The background features a simple dark hatching pattern. A title and text are visible at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Un monsieur  qui se rajeunit
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of two individuals from the waist up. On the right, a man is depicted standing with one hand raised to his head and holding a small jar. He has a sharp, angular face with prominent cheekbones, a long nose, and tousled hair. On the left, a woman is shown facing the man with her hair in a bun and hands clasped together. She wears a checked dress. The background is shaded, and there is text above and below the image related to a publication, including the title "Les Beaux Jours de la Vie" and a dialogue exchange between the characters.

artworks.title: Un mari trop aimé de sa femme
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals from the waist up, in a dynamic pose. On the left, a woman leans towards the man on the right, grabbing his shirt collar. The woman has her hair tied back neatly and a focused expression, wearing a striped dress with a high collar. The man on the right has curly hair and a surprised expression, with wide eyes and raised eyebrows. He wears a shirt with puffed sleeves and seems to be attempting to move away from the woman's hold. The background is simple, with no discernible objects, emphasizing the interaction between the two figures. Jewelry or objects are not visible.

artworks.title: L'amateur de melons
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image features two men holding melons, surrounded by more melons stacked on shelves. The man on the left is in profile, wearing a top hat and a long coat, while the man on the right is facing him, wearing a different hat and coat. The background shows indistinct sketches that may resemble text or additional produce.

artworks.title: Une loterie philantropique
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in the foreground. The woman on the left is holding an open straight razor and gesturing with her other hand. She has a round face with large eyes and an expression of surprise or disbelief. Her hair is covered by a bonnet tied under her chin, and she is wearing a dark shawl or cloak. The man next to her is slightly turned to the side, with a worried expression on his elongated face and wide, staring eyes. He wears a top hat, a dark suit with a high-collared shirt, and holds a small bag in front of him. Behind them, there are partially visible figures wearing top hats, and a sign that reads "LOTERIE PHILANTROPIQUE" can be seen. The background consists of lines and shading, suggesting a textured surface with no distinct features, contributing to the vintage or illustrative style of the artwork.

artworks.title: Un souvenir de gloire
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals seated at a table, leaning slightly towards each other. The individual on the left has white hair and a pipe in their mouth, wearing a dark coat over a light shirt. The person on the right has short, dark hair, facing slightly towards the other person, and is wearing a vest over a shirt. On the table between them is a bottle and a glass. In the background are textured shading and no distinct features. The scene is monochromatic, with text at the top and bottom framing the image.

artworks.title: Mariage chinois
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is a caricature of three full-body figures. Two figures are seated and facing each other. The figure on the left is likely a bride, with her hair tied up and extending one hand towards the figure on the right, likely a groom. In between them is another figure holding a fan and looking straight ahead. The background is plain with faint text or newspaper elements.

artworks.title: Une récompense artistique
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length illustration of a person standing beside a piano. The person is standing with their back partially turned to the viewer, both hands resting on the piano keys. They have long, dark hair cascading over their shoulders. The person's face is visible and angular with sharp features. They are dressed in a long, dark, flowing garment. On the floor near the person's feet, there are three other individuals kneeling. These individuals have hair styled in a topknot and are wearing robes with intricate designs. One of the kneeling individuals is holding a sword, presenting it towards the standing person. The background features artistically rendered, abstract shapes that suggest a decorative wall or curtain, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Les mendians
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene. The image shows three individuals: two standing and conversing, and one seated. The standing figures appear engaged, with one wearing detailed clothing possibly indicating a higher status. The other figure is holding a basket. The seated individual is dressed more simply and appears focused on holding or working with an object resembling a box or small table. The scene is sketched in a monochrome style with lines and shading adding depth and texture to the clothing, cobblestones, and walls. The drawing captures a candid, everyday moment.

artworks.title: Allons! ... On n'a pas encore rendu compte de mon roman ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image portrays several individuals seated at a table. One person, wearing a dark dress and a flowing shawl, is in the foreground on the right. The figure has their head turned to the left, with a veiled face and round spectacles. Dark hair cascades down, and a book or newspaper is on the table in front of them, alongside a glass bottle and carafe. In the background, lighter lines depict other figures at a different table, possibly conversing. The background hints at an indoor setting with walls, a window, and a picture frame.

artworks.title: Un monsieur qui voulu étudier ... les moeurs ... des abeilles
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man running forward with his head down and hands covering his face. He is wearing a dark knee-length coat, trousers, and shoes. The background includes abstractly drawn trees and a large, straw-covered beehive.

artworks.title: Danger de se trouver au milieu d'une course au clocher
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an image of pigs in a chaotic scene. The drawing shows a group of pigs causing commotion. One large pig is near a fallen hat, while another pig interacts with someone on the ground. In the background, a figure holds a whip or stick. The setting depicts a rustic environment with wooden fences and a barn-like structure. The drawing technique includes precise line work and shading, emphasizing movement and texture.

artworks.title: A asnières
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a vineyard harvest. The scene shows grape harvesting in a vineyard, with figures among grapevines. The drawing depicts the activity with detailed lines and shading techniques, creating depth and liveliness. The background includes the sky and landscape, adding to the vineyard atmosphere.
